load_cases.thrust_1.5x_on_ground: 980 g seller thrust x 1.5 per fan, feet still on the ground (no inertia relief), weight 1 g
load_cases.vertical_impact_15.6g: throttle cut from 0.3 m, 2.44 m/s, trunk peak 15.6 g upward (sim qacc, gravity excluded) through the feet, so the side masses carry 16.6 g downward (strength/out/sim_probe/cut03.json: feet 304 N, nacelles 0 at that instant)
load_cases.fore_aft_10g: 10 g horizontal on the side masses (inertia only, trunk struck elsewhere)
load_cases.lateral_10g: 10 g sideways on the side masses (inertia only)
load_cases.handling_lift_by_nacelle: duck (1.9 kg, 2 kg used) lifted by one nacelle's front collar, x 1.5 jerk
load_cases.topple_strike_front_end: duck falls on its face after the fans stop; floor pushes the nacelle front end rearward, 131 N = sim 10 ms mean of the nacelle-box contact (cut03 / hover landing), all on one nacelle; soft MuJoCo contact (20 ms), a hard floor gives more
load_cases.topple_strike_rear_end: duck falls on its back; floor pushes the nacelle rear end forward; same force
load_cases.handling_lift_by_right_nacelle: the same lift by the right nacelle (mirror); wing plate only
